```{r}

library(tidyverse)
```

## How Has Car Fuel Efficiency Changed?

This chart shows how the fuel efficiency of different cars has changed over the years.

```{r}
mpg |>
  group_by(year, class) |>
  summarize(avg_mpg = mean(hwy), .groups = "drop") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = factor(year), y = avg_mpg, fill = class)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge", width = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "plasma") +
  labs(
    title = "Fuel Efficiency by Car Type",
    subtitle = "Average highway MPG in 1999 and 2008",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Average Highway MPG",
    fill = "Car Type",
    caption = "Source: ggplot2 mpg dataset"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "gray40"),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
```
